title: Visiting the Tusset Chapel
subtitle: Opening times, directions and contacts
description: The new Tusset Chapel in Philippsreut is open daily from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Directions via the A3 motorway and the B12 road, and contacts for the chapel and for church services.

blocks.html: Opening times: daily from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
View the chapel on OpenStreetMap

blocks.text: How to reach the new Tusset Chapel

blocks.html: You reach us via the A3 motorway towards Passau, leaving at the Aicha vorm Wald exit. From there continue to Hutthurm. From Hutthurm the B12 road takes you via Freyung to Philippsreut.

blocks.caption: The location of the new Tusset Chapel near the border with the Bohemian Forest

blocks.html: The book on the history of the new Tusset Chapel is available in the chapel and may be purchased for 2.50 €.
